crew.overview: Twenty-eight days after a killer virus was accidentally unleashed from a British research facility, a small group of London survivors are caught in a desperate struggle to protect themselves from the infected. Carried by animals and humans, the virus turns those it infects into homicidal maniacs -- and it's absolutely impossible to contain.
crew.title: 28 Days Later

crew.overview: Heroin addict Mark Renton stumbles through bad ideas and sobriety attempts with his unreliable friends --Sick Boy, Begbie, Spud and Tommy. He also has an underage girlfriend, Diane, along for the ride. After cleaning up and moving from Edinburgh to London, Mark finds he can't escape the life he left behind as Begbie and Sick Boy come knocking.
crew.title: Trainspotting

crew.overview: After a personal tragedy, Sarah joins her friends on a caving expedition in the Appalachian Mountains. But when a rockfall traps them deep underground, their adventure turns into a nightmare. As they search for a way out, the group discovers they are not alone—lurking in the darkness are savage, cave-dwelling creatures. With rising tension and dwindling trust, the women must fight to survive against both the predators and each other.
crew.title: The Descent

crew.overview: Fifty years into the future, the sun is dying, and Earth is threatened by arctic temperatures. A team of astronauts is sent to revive the Sun — but the mission fails. Seven years later, a new team is sent to finish the mission as mankind’s last hope.
crew.title: Sunshine

crew.overview: A chronicle of the decade-long hunt for al-Qaeda terrorist leader Osama bin Laden after the September 2001 attacks, and his death at the hands of the Navy S.E.A.L. Team 6 in May, 2011.
crew.title: Zero Dark Thirty

crew.overview: Chris, a former tennis pro, takes a job as an instructor and befriends his wealthy young student, Tom. After being introduced to his family, Chris is soon engaged to Tom's sister, Chloe. Despite the professional and financial advantages that this relationship affords him, Chris becomes obsessed with Tom's fiancee, American actress Nola.
crew.title: Match Point

crew.overview: Across different eras, a poor family, an anxious developer and a fed-up landlady become tied to the same mysterious house in this animated dark comedy.
crew.title: The House

crew.overview: A teenager reflects on his life after being accused of cheating on the Indian version of "Who Wants to be a Millionaire?".
crew.title: Slumdog Millionaire

crew.overview: The life story of Brazilian football legend, Pele.
crew.title: Pelé: Birth of a Legend

crew.overview: Since the moment they met at age 5, Rosie and Alex have been best friends, facing the highs and lows of growing up side by side. A fleeting shared moment, one missed opportunity, and the decisions that follow send their lives in completely different directions. As each navigates the complexities of life, love, and everything in between, they always find their way back to each other - but is it just friendship, or something more?
crew.title: Love, Rosie

crew.overview: After 20 years abroad, Mark Renton returns to Scotland and reunites with his old friends Sick Boy, Spud and Begbie.
crew.title: T2 Trainspotting

crew.original_title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
crew.overview: Siblings Lucy, Edmund, Susan and Peter step through a magical wardrobe and find the land of Narnia. There, they discover a charming, once peaceful kingdom that has been plunged into eternal winter by the evil White Witch, Jadis. Aided by the wise and magnificent lion, Aslan, the children lead Narnia into a spectacular, climactic battle to be free of the Witch's glacial powers forever.
crew.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe

crew.overview: In WWII's final years, a soldier in the German army, a British glider pilot, and a Dutch resistance fighter's paths intertwine. Their choices shape destinies, impacting not only their freedom but also that of others.
crew.title: The Forgotten Battle

crew.overview: Though young Jane Austen's financially strapped parents expect her to marry the nephew of wealthy Lady Gresham, Jane herself knows that such a union will destroy her creativity and sense of self-worth. Instead, she becomes involved with Tom Lefroy, a charming but penniless apprentice lawyer who gives her the knowledge of the heart she needs for her future career as a novelist.
crew.title: Becoming Jane

crew.overview: A myriad of outrageous calamities befalls an eccentric English clan with more than a few skeletons in its closets when the family's patriarch dies an unexpected death.
crew.title: Death at a Funeral

details.biography: Gail began her career at the Royal Court as Casting Director from 1981 to 1984 before setting up Gail Stevens Casting. Since then she has worked on critically acclaimed and commercially successful films and television programmes including, Your Highness, You Will Meet a Tall Dark Stranger, Slumdog Millionaire, The Chronicles of Narnia (1&2), Matchpoint, Calendar Girls, Defiance, Trainspotting, 28 Days Later, Our Friends in the North, Gnomeo & Juliet, Kathryn Bigelow’s thriller Zero Dark Thirty, Angelina Jolie’s directorial debut In the Land of Blood and Honey, the first two series of MI-5 (Spooks) and Cracker. More recent work includes Brad Furman’s The Infiltrator, Danny Boyle’s Babylon, Julia Davis’ Camping and animated feature film Happy Family amongst others.
details.name: Gail Stevens
